limitations: The theorem covers finite unweighted trees and geodesic halfspaces including the empty and full sets; it does not apply to all convex subsets, cyclic graphs, weighted geodesics or online dimensions. Broad historical priority remains uncertain, notably for phylogenetic split systems.
scientific_integrity_note: The complete infinite-family proof is explicit. Enumerations independently corroborate through six vertices exhaustively and on selected larger trees. Existing VC upper bounds and classical Wiener-index identities are acknowledged. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
title: The Wiener index determines the VC-shattering profile of tree-geodesic halfspaces
